kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 150 (press reports; exchange notice pending). At Rs 150: market cap Rs 930.48 cr post-issue; P/E 34.5x FY26 EPS on post-issue shares (25.0x pre-issue); P/B 2.66x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 17.3x FY26 operating EBITDA. Objects floor Rs 98.27 (capex + working capital over 1.70 crore fresh shares).

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Promoter-group trader Vinsul Makardi Limited: purchases from it Rs 32.35 cr in FY26 (9.3% of revenue) and Rs 8.12 cr in Q1 FY27; sales to it Rs 9.46 cr in FY24 falling to nil; receivable Rs 6.46 cr at Jun-26; Rs 9.00 cr letter of comfort given for it in FY25. Disclosed.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Top customer 31.74% and top-10 66.81% of FY26 revenue; top supplier 71.68% of FY26 raw-material procurement. Typical of a compounder buying resin from a few petrochemical producers; no long-term supply contract stated.

focus.title: Monitoring agency
focus.detail: Fresh issue about Rs 255 cr at the reported upper band: a monitoring agency is required above Rs 50 cr; appointment to be confirmed in the Prospectus.

comfort.detail: Operating cash flow Rs 2.65 cr / 25.13 cr / 38.06 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 7.52 cr / 21.14 cr / 27.01 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT 118.3%. Q1 FY27 CFO -Rs 6.64 cr as receivables rose.

levers.label: Lever 1 - implied perpetual growth on current FCFF
Lever 2 - implied WACC at terminal g
Lever 4 - required NWC % of revenue (steady state)

overhang.label: Promoter holding above 20% of post-issue capital
Promoters' minimum contribution (20% of post-issue capital)

strengths: Enlisted with Maharatna, Navratna and Miniratna CPSEs for cable and pipe-coating compounds; approvals take years (pp. 139, 249)
Operating EBITDA margin up from 5.54% to 11.99% FY24-26 and 14.46% in Q1 FY27 (p. 85)
Cumulative operating cash flow 118% of PAT FY24-26; cash tax 24.7% of PBT (pp. 85-86)
weaknesses: Manufactured polymer revenue Rs 254.42 cr -> Rs 237.00 cr FY24-26 (pp. 406, 408)
Resin trading 31.86% of FY26 revenue, at lower margins (p. 33)
Top customer 31.74% and top-10 66.81% of FY26 revenue (p. 27)
opportunities: Indian polymer compounding market USD 9.9 bn (2025) to USD 16.5 bn by 2031, ~9% CAGR (issuer-paid CRISIL report, p. 179)
GCC distribution arrangement for exports to seven countries (p. 124)
Power-cable and gas-pipeline build-out (National Gas Grid, transmission) (pp. 160-246)
threats: Polyethylene price swings and dependence on a few petrochemical suppliers (p. 39)
Execution and cost-overrun risk on a 148% capacity addition (p. 29)

adjustments.item: Liabilities and provisions written back (in other income)
adjustments.reason: Other income includes write-backs of liabilities 'unpaid for long and deemed no longer payable': Rs 2.80 cr, Rs 4.14 cr and Rs 1.00 cr FY24-26. Non-cash and not from operations.

adjustments.item: Interest waived by related party Basant India Limited
adjustments.reason: Interest of Rs 0.30 cr accrued on a related-party loan in FY24 was waived in FY25, a one-off credit.

adjustments.item: Promoter-family pay at the FY24 level
adjustments.reason: Pay to promoter relatives and a promoter (Rs 2.34 cr in FY24) stopped from FY25; FY26 executive pay was Rs 0.37 cr. A choice that lifts FY25-26 profit, not an accounting entry; shown for information.

adjustments.item: Interest and other income on deposits and receivables
adjustments.reason: Recurring but non-operating; excluding it gives the operating P/E.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by -2.8%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 50.1x reported and 56.4x adjusted.
